entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'd like to start a return for a helmet I bought a few weeks ago. I just haven't had a chance to call until now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference thing. The color just wasn't what I expected when I saw it in person. The box is still unopened, so all the safety features are completely intact.
I understand. Sometimes colors can look a bit different on a screen. Can I get your order number to pull up the details?
Thank you. Let me see... I show the helmet was delivered 28 days ago. One moment while I check our policy.
Okay, I've confirmed it. Since the item is within our 90-day return window, I can go ahead and approve that return for you. I'll email you a return shipping label right now.

That's great news, thank you, Alex. I see the label notes that the return shipping cost will be deducted from my refund. Since I am planning to buy the correct color helmet from VeloFit, would it be possible to get a small discount code to offset that shipping fee on my next purchase?

I appreciate you asking, and I'm glad you're sticking with us for your gear. Unfortunately, my system doesn't allow me to generate discount codes for these types of returns. However, the return approval is all set, and you'll receive a full refund for the item's price once we receive it.
Alright, that's fair enough. I had to try. Thanks for processing the return so quickly for me.
You're very welcome. The email with the return instructions is on its way. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
